item.title: Galen Centre Moots Health Service Commission With Ring-Fenced Five-Year Funding
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The Galen Centre calls for the establishment of a Health Service Commission (SPK) authorised to create and fill positions, and set salary scales, with funding for these positions ring-fenced in a 5-year fiscal framework. item.title: Junior Doctors Work 10 To 15 Overtime Hours Weekly Without Pay: MMI
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MMI says junior doctors in Malaysia work 10-15 unrecorded and unpaid overtime hours weekly. HOs or MOs in Malaysia average at 65-85 weekly working hours, compared to 40 hours in the UK. MMI urges MOH to formalise a Safe Working Hours Policy for doctors. The post Junior Doctors Work 10 To 15 Overtime Hours Weekly Without Pay: MMI appeared first on CodeBlue .
